_comment: COMMITTED G1 residual baseline (ticket sim-agent-G2-v2 Step 0).
Measured on the recorded real set (perception synthetic_openclose_{left,right},
174 detected frames, 870 prox + 870 dist samples) after the kinematics-agent
Finding-1 refactor (r_dist fingertip-inclusive). Geodesic orientation error, rad.
PROXIMAL is a HARD GATE; DISTAL is MONITORED with a regression guard.

proximal._role: HARD GATE: pooled p95 must be <= tol_rad.
proximal._HUMAN_SIGNOFF: PROPOSED 0.15 rad (~8.6 deg) AWAITS SIGN-OFF. NOTE: proximal is NOT near-zero at the tail as the p50=0.000 framing implies; pooled p95=0.1236, max=0.219. The tail is pose-correlated (mid-curl transition frames) and consistent with 2-DoF base under-actuation on transient curled SYNTHETIC poses, not a solver regression. 0.15 gives ~21% headroom over observed p95, sits below distal p95 (0.20), and trips on any real base-solve break. Decision is solver-tuning vs threshold (same axis as distal).

distal._role: MONITORED: report distribution, pass by default, hard-fail on regression beyond regression_margin above the committed baselines below. When G1_DISTAL_RESIDUAL_THRESHOLD is set (real-camera data) it also becomes an absolute gate on the distal pooled p95.
distal._MARGIN_SIGNOFF: PROPOSED regression_margin 0.20 (20%) AWAITS SIGN-OFF: absorbs synthetic re-measure jitter yet trips on a real solver regression (which would push residual >>20%).
